data.content_ref: inline:The proposed CONTRADICTION relation is mischaracterized. The Basin Report's claim that repertoire exhaustion produces refuted attractors and 0e26d6be54fd being an unsampled void (zero probability mass, no conjecture generated) are compatible phenomena, not contradictory ones: some regions of the conjecture space can exhibit refuted-attractor basins while others are never sampled at all. A genuine contradiction requires mutual incompatibility — both claims cannot hold simultaneously — but nothing in the Basin Report's model precludes the existence of unsampled dead zones. The target's own REFUTED IF betrays this: it says the contradiction dissolves if the region actually received refuted proposals, which concedes that the two accounts address different causal scenarios (exhaustion vs. non-sampling) rather than asserting incompatible predictions about the same scenario. The relation kind should be 'complement' or 'alternative,' not 'contradiction.'
